admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
If you decide to leave

You're free to download copies of your own entries before you go - just bear in mind that once a copy has left, the Wing can no longer protect it. Your steward will be told that your account is closed, and at no stage of the closing process is the steward shown any entry or note. Nothing is erased straight away: for fourteen days, reopening your account brings back every journal entry, reflection note and meditation note exactly as you left it. After day fourteen, all of them are erased. The records desk keeps a brief line saying the account existed and when it closed, and holds it for twelve months.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b:
Closing an account

When the member closes their account, journal entries, reflection notes and meditation notes are deleted fourteen days after closing. During those fourteen days the member can reopen the account, and those entries and notes return exactly as they were. Before closing, the member may download a copy of their own entries; once downloaded, a copy is outside the Wing's protection. The steward is told that the account has closed but is not shown any entry or note at any point in the process. A short record that the account existed, and the date it closed, is kept by the Wing records desk for one year.
